verdict.rationale: Graphite Chat on the PR page lets developers ask the AI to explain changes, give context on specific code sections, explain reviewer feedback, and issue commands such as suggested fixes or diagnosing failing CI, all with PR context. The evidence describes a separate chat and agent panel, though, not replying directly to the AI reviewer's comments inside the PR comment thread. Missing for 10: documented in-thread replies to Graphite Agent review comments, conversational follow-up on a specific review comment, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
